title: Surface MCP gateway tool listing failures during server connect or registration
answers: Why does a connected MCP server show no tools without any error?
How should tool discovery errors be handled when connecting or registering an MCP server on Desktop?
Why is an MCP server stuck at Connected with an empty tool list?
body:
Symptom: Connecting or adding an MCP server shows "Connected" or "Added" but displays an empty tool list with no explanation.
Root cause: products/desktop/packages/ui/src/features/mcp-gateway/hooks/useGatewayServers.ts:useGatewayServers and products/desktop/packages/ui/src/features/mcp-gateway/hooks/useRegisterGatewayServer.ts:useRegisterGatewayServer silently caught discoverGatewayTools rejections and ignored skipped: "no-server".
Fix pattern: Catch discovery failures and check for skipped === "no-server" to display a warning toast with static recovery guidance, without failing the underlying server connection or registration.
Constraints: Do not toast when skipped === "no-connection" because the server tag already shows pending OAuth setup. Never interpolate upstream error details into the toast to avoid leaking response fragments (CWE-209).
applies: Desktop MCP gateway server connection and registration hooks in products/desktop/packages/ui/src/features/mcp-gateway/hooks/
